name: Sandboxer
summary: Agent cloud microVMs formerly at sandboxer.com; as of 2026-11-28 the official domain redirects to the North Bay Ventures studio site, which does not document the product.
description: Up-front disclosure (re-checked 2026-11-28): every previously cited sandboxer.com path (the homepage, /docs, /docs/mcp, /pricing, /llms.txt, /terms, /privacy, /openapi.json, /mcp, and /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp) now returns HTTP 301 to https://www.northbayventures.com/?utm_source=sandboxer&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=sandboxer_redirect. This entry does not use that UTM URL as url, docs or sources; the non-UTM destination https://www.northbayventures.com/ returned HTTP 200. The landing page is the North Bay Ventures studio site (North Bay Opco I, Inc., same Miami mailing address previously stated for Sandboxer) and, on this fetch, mentions Transformer.gg and Flagger.gg only — it does not document Sandboxer, pricing, terms, or an MCP server. Hosted MCP, OpenAPI and llms.txt URLs therefore no longer serve those resources, so mcp_endpoint, llms_txt, openapi and docs were removed from this listing. No public GitHub repository was found. The npm package sandboxer-mcp 0.1.0 (MIT per the registry, published 2026-10-24T21:32:22Z = 2026-10-24 23:32:22 Europe/Stockholm; homepage still listed as https://sandboxer.com/docs/mcp) remains on the npm registry; the package was not installed or run. Pricing, Terms, age limits, billing and MCP auth behaviour below were last verified on official sandboxer.com pages on 2026-11-25 and could not be re-verified today. Status is set to unknown because the service can no longer be confirmed live from official pages. Vendor-affiliated listing (listing-queue #52 was submitted by the Sandboxer team; claims below were checked on official sandboxer.com pages, npm, and read-only MCP probes — the queue text and UTM URL were not used as sources). Sandboxer is operated by North Bay Opco I, Inc., a Delaware corporation, mailing address 777 Brickell Ave, Suite 500 PMB 1074, Miami, FL 33131 (hello@sandboxer.com; support@sandboxer.com; legal@sandboxer.com). Official Terms: you must be at least 13, or older if the law where you live sets a higher minimum for using online services without a parent's consent; if you are under 18 (or under the age of majority where you live, if higher) you may use the Service only with a parent or legal guardian who agrees to the Terms and is responsible for the account and payments. Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida; the Federal Arbitration Act governs binding individual arbitration (class actions waived; opt out within 30 days). Official llms.txt and pricing: each sandbox is a full Ubuntu 24.04 Cloud Hypervisor microVM (root, systemd, Docker, nested KVM, SSH, a public HTTPS URL per port), not a container, on dedicated servers Sandboxer operates in us-east (Ashburn, Virginia) and eu-central (Helsinki, Finland). Stopping saves memory and disk; a stopped sandbox costs nothing for compute. Billing is per second while a sandbox runs. Sizes: small 2 vCPU / 4 GB / 12 GB disk at $0.018/h; default 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 50 GB at $0.036/h; large 8 vCPU / 16 GB / 125 GB at $0.072/h; xlarge 16 vCPU / 32 GB / 251 GB at $0.20/h. Plans: $20/month (100 at once), $100 (300), $500 (1,000), $2,000 (2,000); every plan dollar comes back as machine time; extra time comes in $20 packs. Official wording: no free trial; plans start at $20/month, charged when you subscribe; signing up, the docs and the dashboard need no card. Official Terms: included time does not roll over; credit packs do not expire while your account is open. Official Terms (section 8, Closing your account): you may stop using the Service at any time and close your account on the dashboard's Account page or by writing to privacy@sandboxer.com; closing cancels your plan immediately, and any remaining plan time, credit packs and account credit are forfeited without refund. Official Terms: a cancelled subscription runs to the end of the current period and is not refunded for the rest of it; upgrades charge the prorated difference at once; downgrades take effect at the next renewal with no credit for the rest of the period. No SLA during early access; no GPUs. There is no official promise that idle auto-pause minutes in llms.txt (30 to 120 depending on the plan) are a hard spending cap. Host trust: sandboxes are root-capable VMs with Docker and optional public HTTPS URLs, running on Sandboxer's servers, not on the operator's laptop; documented curl|sh CLI install was not executed. The npm package sandboxer-mcp 0.1.0 (published 2026-10-24T21:32:22Z = 2026-10-24 23:32:22 Europe/Stockholm) is MIT according to the npm registry; no public GitHub repository was found. The hosted service is proprietary. Official docs: hosted MCP at https://sandboxer.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP) uses OAuth in browser clients or an API key in headless clients; local `sbx mcp` or `npx sandboxer-mcp` was not run. OpenAPI 3.1.0 title "Sandboxer Public API v1" version 1.0.0 at https://sandboxer.com/openapi.json (also yaml). No account, key, or spend; tools were not called.

agent_access.notes: As of 2026-11-28, sandboxer.com (including /mcp, /llms.txt, /openapi.json and the previously documented OAuth metadata URL) HTTP 301-redirects to the North Bay Ventures studio homepage; those resources no longer serve MCP, OpenAPI or llms.txt. No replacement hosted MCP URL was found. The npm package sandboxer-mcp 0.1.0 is still on the registry (not installed or run). No account, key, or spend.
